verdicts.reason: A breaks the content: the three steps are microscopic, scattered and out of order (02 before 01, 03 stranded at the bottom right), the 'Pour-over, properly' eyebrow sits orphaned beside the CTA, and the logo is shrunk into the footer. B keeps everything readable and in order, but it is just a scaled-down copy of the portrait layout. Its columns are staggered (logo, headline, steps and CTA each start at a different x), the bag sits tiny in the top-right corner, the footer is illegible and there is a lot of dead space.

A's headline is huge but the steps are unreadable specks spread across the canvas (01 at the upper right, 02 and 03 at the bottom), the eyebrow is stranded in the top-left corner, the legal line floats over the decorative circle and the logo is jammed against the CTA. B (the same render as pair 1 B) keeps the reading order and readable step copy, but its alignment is ragged, the bag is small, the space is badly used and the footer is too small to read.
